title: A predictive signal model for dynamic cardiac magnetic resonance imaging.
summary: A patient-adaptive temporal signal model improves dynamic cardiac MRI reconstruction on simulated irregular rhythms and prospectively undersampled clinical scans, with comparisons across two reconstruction frameworks.
ai_technology: adaptively learn a predictive temporal signal model from a small training set from the same patient.
organization: The Edward S. Rogers Sr. Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, University of Toronto, Toronto, Canada

evidence.tested: A patient-adaptive temporal signal model improves dynamic cardiac MRI reconstruction on simulated irregular rhythms and prospectively undersampled clinical scans, with comparisons across two reconstruction frameworks.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
